answer: Flooding registration pushes anyone to the back of the relic queue while genuine members promoted earlier still earns. Admission is quota-limited: at most 1145 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the mesa. The fable index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. A 430 account operation therefore ties up 27 million dollars of idle capital. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
